_comment: Finn-loop configuration for this repository. The loop is three stages - the skills at ~/.claude/skills/finn-{spec,build,review} - and they read this file to learn which repo, team and checks they are operating on. Without it they refuse to run. This file reproduces the behaviour the skills previously hardcoded. Ideation is not a loop stage; /finn-ideate is a separate on-demand tool configured in .claude/finn-ideate.json.

afterEdit.note: Static assets are immutable for a year in _headers, so a changed file at an unchanged URL is cached stale by the CDN. check-cache-bust re-stamps the ?v= content hashes (never hand-edit them); prerender regenerates the per-route HTML. Commit whatever they regenerate.

guardrails: Never introduce ServiceNow "partner", "authorised" or "certified" language. scripts/check-trademark-risk.py forbids it and will fail the gate. Halo partner language is allowed.
Never hand-edit a ?v= query string. It is a content hash stamped by scripts/check-cache-bust.py --fix.
After editing index.html, re-run scripts/prerender.py and commit the regenerated route files. The prerender-drift check fails otherwise.
A SKIPPED check counts as a FAIL. scripts/pre-push-check.sh must exit 0 with no check skipped.
